== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The term "the Sword" refers to several distinct entities and objects within the narrative. It is a title held by different individuals, including an officer responsible for weapons and a person who serves [[Horizon]]. [[Sola Kalter]] is known as the [[Fallen Sword]], an independent operative characterized by her exceptional ability to utilize [[Aethertech]] weaponry during her campaign against the [[Iron Legion]]. This individual is also identified as the Sword of [[The Last Horizon]]. Physically, various swords appear throughout the text. These include force-blades that project light in colors such as gold, red, or white, and some that function as massive broadswords infused with fire. Other examples include single-edged [[Aethertech]] or [[Combat Art]] blades, and a unique metal [[sword]] that possesses sentience, capable of speaking, floating, and evaluating individuals. Additionally, the [[Zenith Blade]] is described as a silver broadsword that resembles a specific entity's form.}}
